limitations: This is an AI report-to-artifact review, not human gold judgment, new model experiment, or reader-outcome validation.
Fresh-context isolation and full reading are workflow claims; inspecting outputs or hashes cannot prove complete semantic coverage.
Primary semantic verdicts, especially materiality of stronger modality and conservative dependency closure, remain interpretive. Report qualifies them appropriately.
The six synthetic bundles are authored stimuli and the two real bundles are exposed regressions; they do not estimate general performance.
Whole-tree historical v12 immutability was not independently re-audited here; checkpoint preservation beyond inspected references remains dependent on the parent manifest.
Review did not edit raw inputs, proposals, judgments, protocols, scores, or report text.
